note: Blind read (Opus, fenced from cruces). 3 sites, all OURS repaired. ⭐⭐⭐ MARQUEE: 0748C a bare 'he' that INVERTS A THEOLOGICAL CLAIM — the only antecedent the English offered was Christ, but *historialiter* marks the literal register whose subject is ASSUERUS; as written the page said Christ did not make all the earth tributary because he did not possess it, contradicting *implevit totum mundum* eight words earlier. Also 0745A Migne's concessive *si* wholly unrendered, so the English read as an emendation (*qui prius videbatur*) that nobody declared; 0746B a supplied subject over a NOUNLESS ablative absolute, left unbracketed in a work that brackets everywhere else. ⭐⭐ THE MEASURED ZERO: scripture-conformation hunt came back EMPTY — every guilleted quotation checked, the English follows Migne not the familiar Bible at all ~15 divergences (Hab 3:8 on *equitatus*/*sanitas* not Douay's chariots; 1 Thess 4 on *resurgemus*/*residui sumus*). Ruth's four conformations on this same ground in this same volume are the contrast that gives the zero its value. ⚑ All three defects were in GLOSS PROSE, none in a lemma — same split as 2 Thess. The lemma list does its job and does not cover the sentences between lemmata. ⚑ A cruces entry ASSERTED the *si* had been rendered when it had not — a note that a call was made is not evidence it reached the sentence.
